key_path: Sign up at app.launchdarkly.com/signup (email or SSO/social); free Developer plan, 'No credit card required'
Project + environments (with SDK keys) are created by default
Credential: `ldcli login` (link to the UI, approve CLI access, token stored in config), or Account settings > Authorization > create API access token; or `ldcli setup` to create a first flag + SDK
human_gates: browser approval for ldcli login / MCP OAuth

agent_native_auth.cli_browser_or_device_login: yes: `ldcli login` gives an approval link and stores the access token
agent_native_auth.oauth_dcr_for_mcp: yes: hosted MCP servers use OAuth from the client
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: yes: REST API can create access tokens, projects, environments
agent_native_auth.scoped_keys: yes: access tokens by role/custom role; separate SDK/mobile/client-side IDs per environment
agent_native_auth.test_dev_instances: yes: environments (Test/Production) per project; `ldcli dev-server` for local flags
agent_native_auth.free_tier: yes: Developer plan $0 forever, no card; 14-day trial for pay-as-you-go
agent_native_auth.keyless_claimable_dev_mode: partial: ldcli dev-server serves local flag values offline, but still syncs from a real project

mcp.local: npx @launchdarkly/mcp-server with an API access token (local MCP page in docs)
mcp.one_click: yes: install pages https://mcp.launchdarkly.com/mcp/fm/install and /aiconfigs/install with per-client buttons

docs_for_agents.agent_skills: LaunchDarkly agent skills page; Copilot flag-cleanup custom agent

score_justification: Free plan with no card, OAuth hosted MCP with one-click install pages, and CLI login. Email verification is still needed and llms.txt points at a preview domain.
best_practice: Per-client MCP install pages, and splitting the MCP into two domain servers (flags vs AI Configs) to keep tool lists small
biggest_gap: llms.txt links all point to launchdarkly-preview.mintlify.app (looks like a misconfigured or stale preview host); no claimable or anonymous path
